Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the raven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 344 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
